name: krishi-sahayak-b2c
description: Krishi Sahayak — 100% Free B2C Multilingual Farmer Guidance PWA & Android App (Google Cloud Always-Free)

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['public','web_app','dist','android_app/app/src/main/assets/pwa'].forEach(d => { fs.mkdirSync(d, {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('web_simulator', d, {recursive:true}); }); console.log('Build output ready: web_app, public, dist & android_app/assets/pwa');"
